_comment: M-DEPTH DP5: THE DELIVERY BOARD's live pool (the Runner's Guild). Assembled from docs/design/board-staging/runner-deliveries.json (writer lane, 2026-07-06) -- parcel/destination/gold/band/slip_copy carried over verbatim, _notes/_comment_* annotations stripped per the G2/DP2 discipline. RIDES WIBounties (DP2's bounty machinery, extended not forked): `condition` is the ONE field the staging doc didn't author, because the plan's reach-condition ("reach map/cell X with the parcel") can't be expressed as an accomplishment-counter threshold directly -- WIGame._check_delivery_arrival (the smallest honest reuse of the trigger_radius seam: Chebyshev/king-move adjacency to the destination's anchor_entity, checked from a REAL move_player only, parcel-in-pack as the guard) is the ONE producer of a `delivered_<id>` accomplishment per delivery, so `condition: {"delivered_<id>": 1}` rides WIBounties.condition_met completely unchanged. MODE TRACE (the DP2 fix wave's delta/absolute split, decided deliberately per delivery -- all five land the same way): every entry uses the DEFAULT "delta" mode, deliberately NOT "absolute". Absolute exists for conditions a player can bank BEFORE ever accepting (DP2's one-shot soft-lock class); `delivered_<id>` is structurally un-bankable pre-accept (the parcel only exists in the pack while THIS slip is held), so that soft-lock class cannot occur here -- and delta is additionally REQUIRED for re-acceptance honesty: `delivered_<id>` persists after a completed run (accomplishments are monotonic), so an absolute read would insta-complete the same posting taken again after a rotation, paying twice for one carry; delta's accept-time baseline forces a FRESH arrival per acceptance. Pool order: keep stable going forward (WIBounties.active_slate's rotation window is order-sensitive, the bounties.json convention; delivery_loop pins the slate ids at times_slept 0 and 1). `delivery_hermit_antlers` (runner-deliveries.json's 6th, FORWARD-REF) is PARKED, not shipped: its destination is null until HR-II places the hermit-alchemist, per the staging doc's own instruction -- and its BINDING double-pay hazard note travels with it: docs/design/dialogue-drafts/home_region_2/hermit_antler_order.json already stages this SAME delivery as a dialogue beat paying 2g at the hermit's door, so HR-II must reconcile (either the hermit conversation IS the turn-in surface [his 2g + a 2g balance at the counter = the 4g band] or the board pays the full 4 and the dialogue's gold effect is dropped) BEFORE either surface ships live -- never both untouched. Resolved for THIS task by shipping neither: no hermit entry here, and hermit_antler_order.json stays a draft outside data/, so no live double-pay path exists.

parcel.flavor: A bolt of plains-wool, paper-wrapped, smelling of lanolin and a long walk.

deliveries.slip_copy: TO: Silverfang stall, market row. One wool bolt. Same waking. The Gnoll pays for dry, not for fast — it rains here, keep the paper on it.

parcel.flavor: A parcel that ticks. Do not shake. The sender says it is a metronome. The sender laughed.

deliveries.slip_copy: TO: the [Necromancer] by the Guild steps. Yes, that one. It ticks. It is SUPPOSED to tick. Do not shake it, do not ask him what it is, do not linger. Same waking.

parcel.flavor: Watch dispatches, string-tied, sealed thrice. The third seal is the Captain's habit, not protocol.

deliveries.slip_copy: TO: Watch Captain Sunderscale, the gate. Dispatches. Priority. If a guardsman stops you, show the seals and keep walking — that is what the seals are FOR. Before the shift bell.

parcel.flavor: Six glass phials of lamp-spirit for the grate crew, cotton-chocked. If it clinks when you set it down, it is already broken.

deliveries.slip_copy: TO: drainage crew, Market Street grate. GLASS. Walk like it's your grandmother's teeth. Same waking, and the crew counts the phials in front of you, so arrive with six.

parcel.flavor: A hamper of Amentus blue fruit, straw-packed, the poison cores already cut out. You were told twice.

deliveries.slip_copy: TO: The Wandering Inn, the hill past the gate. One fruit hamper for the [Innkeeper]. Juice is on tonight's menu, so: tonight. The road has goblins. The hamper has a poison core policy. Read the label.
